categories.description: A single disciplined two-leg player-prop slip from consensus-qualified, market-priced props.
categories.label: Prop Double

notices: Leg probabilities are anchored to market prices and adjusted only by each source's proven trailing excess.
No same-game, same-player, or same-side duplicate legs are allowed; game keys are canonicalized across sources.
Slates without qualified edges show fewer cards (or none) instead of forcing action.
A card is unpublished when its own parlay EV is zero or negative.
No qualified parlay cards met the trailing-edge, price, and overlap rules for this slate.

trackResearch.note: Research only. These are not placed tickets and not verified edge. Combined prices are estimates from comparison quotes, not an executable app parlay price.

notes.favorite_parlay: Alt-spread legs still need a margin check; price alone does not qualify a leg.
notes.multiplier_parlay: Generic 2-3x research band; not a book-specific ticket.
notes.streak_candidate: Not a daily requirement. Verify model probability and market agreement in the source cache before use.

trackResearch.screen: The 90% screen is the vigged implied probability of the posted price, not a true win probability.
